extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and patent searchers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on identification, use, and handling of prior art and on patent classification and searching practices at the USPTO. Covers sources of prior art, classification systems (USPC, CPC, IPC, Locarno), search methods, and routing/docketing/classification procedures.
